tutorial.welcome: Welcome to 5x5GAME, a unique puzzle experience designed to challenge your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. Navigate through a grid and reach the goal number, 25, using strategic moves. This guide will walk you through the basics of the game, the rules, and strategies to help you succeed.
tutorial.game_overview_1: In 5x5GAME, your objective is to navigate a 5x5 grid and reach the goal number, 25. You must move strategically across the grid, taking calculated leaps both vertically, horizontally, and diagonally.
tutorial.starting_the_game_1: When you start the game, you'll see a 5x5 grid. and you need to click on an empty tile to start
tutorial.vertical_horizontal_moves_1: You can move vertically or horizontally by 3 steps at a time. For example, if your last move is on tile 1x1, you can move to tile 1x4 or 4x1, provided these tiles are within the grid and not already visited.
tutorial.diagonal_moves_1: You can move diagonally by 2 steps at a time. For example, if you are on tile 3x3, you can move to tile 1x1, 5x1, 1x5 or 5x5, provided these tiles are within the grid and not already visited.
tutorial.objective_1: Plan your moves to reach the goal number, 25. Avoid landing on the same tile more than once.
tutorial.gameplay_1: Click or tap on a tile to visit it. Only valid moves will be allowed. Think ahead and plan your path to ensure you can reach the goal.
